variables.name: DB_MODE

variables.name: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME
variables.description:
Compose project name. Pinned because the monitoring stack joins this project's network by
name, and Compose would otherwise derive it from the clone's directory name.

variables.name: DOCKER_REGISTRY
variables.description: Registry prefix for the api, worker and ui images; defaults to ghcr.io/vadymkykalo/railhook.

variables.name: APP_ENV
variables.description: development | staging | production. Production refuses to start with placeholder secrets.

variables.name: APP_BASE_URL
variables.description:
Public origin of the dashboard, used in emails, shared links, canonical tags and the sitemap.
Include the port when it is not 80, e.g. http://localhost:8080.

variables.name: POSTGRES_IMAGE
variables.description: Image and credentials of the PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Image and credentials of the PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
variables.description: Image and credentials of the PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Image and credentials of the PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Database connection; DB_HOST stays `postgres` (the Compose service) in embedded mode.

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: Database connection; DB_HOST stays `postgres` (the Compose service) in embedded mode.

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: Database connection; DB_HOST stays `postgres` (the Compose service) in embedded mode.

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: Database connection; DB_HOST stays `postgres` (the Compose service) in embedded mode.

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database connection; DB_HOST stays `postgres` (the Compose service) in embedded mode.

variables.name: DB_SSL_MODE
variables.description: disable | require | verify-full

variables.name: DB_JDBC_URL
variables.description: Full JDBC URL; when set, DB_HOST, DB_PORT and DB_NAME are ignored.

variables.name: DB_POOL_MAX_SIZE
variables.description:
API connection pool (connections; timeout in ms). Named apart from the worker's on purpose:
a shared name once gave the worker the API's smaller pool.

variables.name: DB_POOL_MIN_IDLE
variables.description:
API connection pool (connections; timeout in ms). Named apart from the worker's on purpose:
a shared name once gave the worker the API's smaller pool.

variables.name: DB_POOL_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
variables.description:
API connection pool (connections; timeout in ms). Named apart from the worker's on purpose:
a shared name once gave the worker the API's smaller pool.

variables.name: WORKER_DB_POOL_MAX_SIZE
variables.description:
Worker connection pool. Smaller than the worker's thread count because no transaction spans
the outbound HTTP call; check hikari_connections_pending under load before changing it.

variables.name: WORKER_DB_POOL_MIN_IDLE
variables.description:
Worker connection pool. Smaller than the worker's thread count because no transaction spans
the outbound HTTP call; check hikari_connections_pending under load before changing it.

sections.title: Redis configuration (for distributed rate limiting & concurrency)

variables.name: REDIS_IMAGE
variables.description: Redis image, address, password and memory cap.

variables.name: REDIS_HOST
variables.description: Redis image, address, password and memory cap.

variables.name: REDIS_PORT
variables.description: Redis image, address, password and memory cap.

variables.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
variables.description: Redis image, address, password and memory cap.

variables.name: REDIS_MAXMEMORY
variables.description: Redis image, address, password and memory cap.

variables.name: KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
variables.description: Kafka bootstrap servers: kafka:9092 in embedded mode, your cluster otherwise.

variables.name: KAFKA_IMAGE
variables.description: Kafka bootstrap servers: kafka:9092 in embedded mode, your cluster otherwise.

variables.name: KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS
variables.description: Partitions per topic; the ceiling on consumer parallelism.

variables.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP_ID
variables.description: Consumer group IDs; prefix them with the environment on a shared cluster.

variables.name: KAFKA_INCOMING_GROUP_ID
variables.description: Consumer group IDs; prefix them with the environment on a shared cluster.

variables.name: KAFKA_DELIVERY_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Outgoing delivery consumer threads; keep at or below KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS.

variables.name: KAFKA_INCOMING_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Incoming forward consumer threads; keep at or below KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS.

variables.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: How long one producer send may keep retrying (ms); an expired send is retried from the outbox.

variables.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_MAX_BLOCK_MS
variables.description:
How long send() may block on cluster metadata (ms). Kafka's 60s default would hold the
shared scheduler threads the outbox publisher runs on.

variables.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_AUTO_OFFSET_RESET
variables.description: Worker consumer offset reset policy and retries on a failed record (interval in ms).

variables.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Worker consumer offset reset policy and retries on a failed record (interval in ms).

variables.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Worker consumer offset reset policy and retries on a failed record (interval in ms).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Key that encrypts stored secrets, 32+ characters. Change it in production.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_SALT
variables.description: PBKDF2 salt for the AES-256 key, 16+ characters, unique per deployment. Change it in production.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEYS
variables.description: Keys for zero-downtime rotation as "version:key,version:key"; empty uses WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY as version 1.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ACTIVE_VERSION
variables.description: Key version new encryptions use; 0 picks the highest.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT signing secret, 32+ characters. Change it in production.

variables.name: PLATFORM_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.description:
Token for /api/v1/admin/** (X-Platform-Admin-Token header), including key rotation across all
organizations; an organization OWNER does not get this. Empty keeps those endpoints closed.

variables.name: PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS
variables.description:
Comma-separated emails allowed into the platform admin panel (sign-in under 12 hours old).
Empty means nobody.

variables.name: API_IMAGE_TAG
variables.description: API image tag.

variables.name: WORKER_IMAGE_TAG
variables.description: Worker image tag.

variables.name: SCHEDULING_POOL_SIZE
variables.description:
Threads shared by all scheduled jobs. Keep at 8 or more: with Spring's default of 1, one slow
job stalls every other one, outbox dispatch included.

variables.name: RAILHOOK_PORT
variables.description:
Host port and bind address of the dashboard's nginx, the only published port; it also proxies
the API. Use RAILHOOK_BIND=127.0.0.1 behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: RAILHOOK_BIND
variables.description:
Host port and bind address of the dashboard's nginx, the only published port; it also proxies
the API. Use RAILHOOK_BIND=127.0.0.1 behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: RAILHOOK_DOMAIN
variables.description: Domain and ACME contact for the built-in Caddy TLS terminator (COMPOSE_PROFILES=tls).

variables.name: ACME_EMAIL
variables.description: Domain and ACME contact for the built-in Caddy TLS terminator (COMPOSE_PROFILES=tls).

variables.name: UI_IMAGE_TAG
variables.description: UI image tag.

variables.name: VITE_API_URL
variables.description:
Build-time only: API origin baked into the UI bundle. Leave empty; the UI's nginx proxies the
API on the same origin. If set, add it to CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS too.

variables.name: VITE_CSP_EXTRA_CONNECT
variables.description: Build-time only: extra CSP connect-src origins, space-separated.

variables.name: RAILHOOK_CONTACT_DOMAIN
variables.description:
Domain for the sales@ and support@ addresses on /contact and in the footer, e.g. example.com.
Empty offers no addresses. Read by the ui container at start.

variables.name: OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Poll interval for pending outbox messages (ms).

variables.name: OUTBOX_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Retry interval for failed outbox messages (ms).

variables.name: OUTBOX_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Cleanup interval for PUBLISHED and DEAD outbox messages (ms).

variables.name: OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Messages per poll.

variables.name: OUTBOX_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Publish retries before a message goes DEAD.

variables.name: OUTBOX_DEAD_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days DEAD messages are kept for manual re-drive.

variables.name: OUTBOX_SENDING_RECOVERY_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds before a stuck SENDING message returns to PENDING; must exceed KAFKA_PRODUCER_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS.

variables.name: OUTBOX_BATCH_SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds to wait for a batch of Kafka sends to complete.

variables.name: OUTBOX_MAX_PER_PROJECT
variables.description: Messages claimed per project per batch, so one project cannot crowd out the rest.

variables.name: OUTBOX_MAX_PER_KEY
variables.description:
Messages claimed per endpoint per batch. With a 1000 ms poll this caps one endpoint at 10
events/s whatever OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE is; raise it only when one endpoint dominates.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_ATTEMPTS_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep failed and successful (2xx) Attempts, and received incoming events.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_SUCCESSFUL_ATTEMPTS_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep failed and successful (2xx) Attempts, and received incoming events.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_INCOMING_EVENTS_DAYS
variables.description: Days to keep failed and successful (2xx) Attempts, and received incoming events.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_EVENTS_DAYS
variables.description:
Days to keep Events and, by cascade, their Deliveries; -1 keeps them forever. The only bound
on those tables when billing is off. Matches DATA_RETENTION_ATTEMPTS_DAYS on purpose.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_DELIVERY
variables.description: Most recent Attempts kept per Delivery.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Rows per cleanup batch.

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_CRON
variables.description: Cleanup schedule (cron, daily at 2 AM).

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_LIMIT_CRON
variables.description: Limit enforcement schedule (cron, every 30 minutes).

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_BURST_CLEANUP_CRON
variables.description: Extra cleanup for daytime error spikes (cron, every 4 hours).

variables.name: DATA_RETENTION_TABLE_METRICS_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Table size gauge refresh interval (ms).

variables.name: PARTITION_MAINTENANCE_ENABLED
variables.description:
Creates delivery_attempts and tunnel_request_log partitions ahead of need and drops those past
retention; lookahead in months and weeks, schedule as cron.

variables.name: PARTITION_MAINTENANCE_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS_LOOKAHEAD_MONTHS
variables.description:
Creates delivery_attempts and tunnel_request_log partitions ahead of need and drops those past
retention; lookahead in months and weeks, schedule as cron.

variables.name: PARTITION_MAINTENANCE_TUNNEL_LOG_LOOKAHEAD_WEEKS
variables.description:
Creates delivery_attempts and tunnel_request_log partitions ahead of need and drops those past
retention; lookahead in months and weeks, schedule as cron.

variables.name: PARTITION_MAINTENANCE_CRON
variables.description:
Creates delivery_attempts and tunnel_request_log partitions ahead of need and drops those past
retention; lookahead in months and weeks, schedule as cron.

variables.name: GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
variables.description: Platform-wide request limit per instance (requests/s).

variables.name: ORG_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
variables.description:
Per-organization request limit (requests/s), for shared installs where one tenant must not spend
everyone's budget. Costs a Redis round trip per request, so leave it off when self-hosting.

variables.name: ORG_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
variables.description:
Per-organization request limit (requests/s), for shared installs where one tenant must not spend
everyone's budget. Costs a Redis round trip per request, so leave it off when self-hosting.

variables.name: GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
variables.description:
Per-organization request limit (requests/s), for shared installs where one tenant must not spend
everyone's budget. Costs a Redis round trip per request, so leave it off when self-hosting.

variables.name: EVENT_INGESTION_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
variables.description: Events per second per project (token bucket).

variables.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_MINUTE
variables.description: Sign-in and registration attempts per minute, per IP and per email.

variables.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_REGISTER_PER_MINUTE
variables.description: Sign-in and registration attempts per minute, per IP and per email.

variables.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_REFRESH_PER_TOKEN_PER_MINUTE
variables.description:
Session refreshes per minute, per refresh token and per IP. Separate from sign-in, whose budget
page loads would otherwise exhaust.

variables.name: AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_REFRESH_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE
variables.description:
Session refreshes per minute, per refresh token and per IP. Separate from sign-in, whose budget
page loads would otherwise exhaust.

variables.name: AUTH_BCRYPT_STRENGTH
variables.description: BCrypt cost, 4-31; each step doubles the work. Changing it never invalidates stored hashes.

variables.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_ENABLED
variables.description:
Lock an account after consecutive failed sign-ins. Held in Postgres, not Redis, so it does not
weaken when Redis is down. Locks expire on their own and a password reset clears them.

variables.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Consecutive failures before the account locks.

variables.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_INITIAL_SECONDS
variables.description: First lockout, in seconds. Doubles with each further failure.

variables.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_MAX_SECONDS
variables.description: Cap on the doubling, in seconds; longer only helps someone locking a stranger out.

variables.name: AUTH_LOCKOUT_FAILURE_WINDOW_MINUTES
variables.description: Minutes after which a failure no longer counts toward the lockout.

variables.name: AUTH_SESSION_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Interval for purging expired sessions (ms).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE_BYTES
variables.description: Largest event payload accepted (bytes).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_FANOUT_PER_EVENT
variables.description: Most Deliveries one Event may fan out to.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD_BYTES
variables.description: Payloads larger than this are stored gzip-compressed (bytes).

variables.name: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENSION_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
variables.description:
Seconds an organization's suspension state is cached on each node; other nodes see a change
within this window.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_PROJECT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
variables.description:
Deliveries per second one project may take from the shared worker pool. Not the plan's ingest
limit: size it from WEBHOOK_OUTGOING_POOL_SIZE.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
variables.description: Require new endpoints to prove ownership before they receive deliveries (true | false).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_INGRESS_REPLAY_WINDOW_MINUTES
variables.description:
Minutes a received signature is remembered to reject replays. For a source signed with a plain
body HMAC this is the only replay bound; raise it for such sources.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS
variables.description: Allow delivery to private IPs (SSRF risk, e.g. cloud metadata). Development only; refused in production.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Concurrent deliveries per endpoint.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_TENANT
variables.description:
Concurrent in-flight attempts per organization across all its endpoints, so one tenant's slow
receivers cannot occupy the whole WEBHOOK_OUTGOING_POOL_SIZE.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_CONCURRENCY_PERMIT_LEASE_SECONDS
variables.description:
Seconds a concurrency permit lives before Redis reclaims it; must exceed the 60s maximum
delivery timeout plus setup time.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_OUTGOING_POOL_SIZE
variables.description: Threads for outgoing deliveries.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_INCOMING_POOL_SIZE
variables.description: Threads for incoming forwards.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight deliveries on shutdown.

variables.name: CLIENT_ERROR_REPORTING_ENABLED
variables.description:
Dashboard error reporting.

Dashboard errors are posted back and written to this installation's own logs, never to a
third party; reports per user per minute.

variables.name: CLIENT_ERROR_REPORTS_PER_USER_PER_MINUTE
variables.description:
Dashboard error reporting.

Dashboard errors are posted back and written to this installation's own logs, never to a
third party; reports per user per minute.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_RESPONSE_BODY_BYTES
variables.description:
Receiver response body buffered per attempt (bytes); past it the status code alone decides.
Only the first 10 KiB is stored.

variables.name: TRANSFORM_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description:
JavaScript transformations.

Wall-clock limit per script run (ms); a runaway script holds one delivery slot this long. Exceeding
any of these limits fails the Delivery, which is retried.

variables.name: TRANSFORM_SCRIPT_MAX_MEMORY_MB
variables.description: Allocation limit per run (MB), counted as total allocation rather than live heap.

variables.name: TRANSFORM_SCRIPT_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
variables.description: Largest body a script may return (bytes).

variables.name: TRANSFORM_SCRIPT_MAX_CONSOLE_LINES
variables.description: console.* lines kept per run for the Transform Studio.

variables.name: TRANSFORM_SCRIPT_MAX_CHARS
variables.description: Largest script the engine compiles (characters).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_POOL_MAX_CONNECTIONS
variables.description: Outgoing HTTP connection pool shared by deliveries and forwards (connections, seconds).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_POOL_PENDING_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Outgoing HTTP connection pool shared by deliveries and forwards (connections, seconds).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_POOL_MAX_IDLE_TIME_SECONDS
variables.description: Outgoing HTTP connection pool shared by deliveries and forwards (connections, seconds).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description:
Comma-separated host names exempt from the private-IP check, matched as written in the endpoint
URL. Empty exempts nothing; other rules still apply.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description:
Comma-separated proxy IPs/CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For sets the client IP (rate limits, audit,
source IP checks); behind a CDN include its ranges. Empty trusts nothing.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_INGRESS_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL for ingress URLs shown in the dashboard.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_INCOMING_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE_BYTES
variables.description: Largest incoming payload accepted (bytes).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_INCOMING_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
variables.description: Default ingress limit for a source that sets none (requests/s); 0 disables the default.

variables.name: INCOMING_FORWARD_RETRY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Incoming forward retry scheduler: poll interval (ms), batch size, and per-destination cap.

variables.name: INCOMING_FORWARD_RETRY_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Incoming forward retry scheduler: poll interval (ms), batch size, and per-destination cap.

variables.name: INCOMING_FORWARD_RETRY_MAX_PER_DEST
variables.description: Incoming forward retry scheduler: poll interval (ms), batch size, and per-destination cap.

variables.name: INCOMING_FORWARD_RETRY_HIGH_WATERMARK
variables.description: Pending forward retries above which the governor shrinks batches.

variables.name: DLQ_MONITORING_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: DLQ monitoring interval (ms).

variables.name: DLQ_MONITORING_ADMIN_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Timeout for DLQ monitoring's Kafka admin calls (seconds).

variables.name: ORDERING_GAP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description:
Seconds an ordered Delivery waits on a gap before going out of order, and only once nothing in
the gap is being or about to be attempted.

variables.name: ORDERING_BUFFER_RESCHEDULE_DELAY_SECONDS
variables.description: Fallback poll for a Delivery parked behind a missing sequence (seconds).

variables.name: ORDERING_DELIVERED_SEQ_TTL_HOURS
variables.description: TTL of delivered-sequence tracking in Redis (hours).

variables.name: ORDERING_BUFFER_TTL_MINUTES
variables.description: TTL of the ordering buffer in Redis (minutes).

variables.name: ORDERING_BUFFER_GAUGE_RESYNC_MS
variables.description: How often the ordering buffer size gauge resyncs from Redis (ms).

variables.name: ORDERING_STRANDED_SEQUENCE_AFTER_SECONDS
variables.description:
Backfills ordered Deliveries left without a sequence number by a process that died after
commit; only rows older than this many seconds, per batch. Below a few seconds it races ingest.

variables.name: ORDERING_STRANDED_SEQUENCE_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description:
Backfills ordered Deliveries left without a sequence number by a process that died after
commit; only rows older than this many seconds, per batch. Below a few seconds it races ingest.

variables.name: ORDERING_SEQUENCE_RECONCILIATION_LOOKBACK_HOURS
variables.description: How far back sequence reconciliation looks for active ordered endpoints (hours).

variables.name: ORDERING_SEQUENCE_RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Sequence reconciliation interval (ms).

variables.name: REPLAY_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Events read per replay batch.

variables.name: REPLAY_BATCH_DELAY_MS
variables.description: Pause between replay batches (ms).

variables.name: REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS_PER_SESSION
variables.description: Most events one replay session may cover.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Largest retry batch; the governor adapts below it.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_MAX_PER_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Retries claimed per endpoint per poll.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_MAX_PER_PROJECT
variables.description: Retries claimed per project per poll.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_HIGH_WATERMARK
variables.description: Pending retries above which the governor shrinks batches, avoiding a retry storm after an outage.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds to wait for a Kafka send to be confirmed.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_RESCHEDULE_DELAY_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds before a failed send is rescheduled.

variables.name: RETRY_SCHEDULER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Baseline poll interval (ms); the governor polls 3x slower when idle and up to 5x faster under backlog.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_RETRY_AFTER_MAX_SECONDS
variables.description:
Longest a receiver's Retry-After (on 429 and 503) may delay the next attempt (seconds); it only
ever delays. 0 ignores the header. Kept within DELIVERY_ESCALATION_HARD_CAP_HOURS.

variables.name: STUCK_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
variables.description: Minutes after which a Delivery stuck in PROCESSING is reset.

variables.name: STUCK_DELIVERY_STRANDED_PENDING_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
variables.description:
Minutes after which an unclaimed PENDING Delivery with no retry time is reset; keep well above
the normal dispatch time.

variables.name: STUCK_DELIVERY_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Check interval (ms).

variables.name: STUCK_FORWARD_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
variables.description: Minutes after which a Forward stuck in PROCESSING is reset.

variables.name: STUCK_FORWARD_STRANDED_PENDING_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
variables.description:
Minutes after which a PENDING Forward with no retry time goes back to the retry scheduler; keep
well above the normal dispatch time.

variables.name: STUCK_FORWARD_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Check interval (ms).

variables.name: ENDPOINT_AUTO_DISABLE_ENABLED
variables.description:
Turn off an endpoint or destination that has only failed for a whole window, and notify its
owners. Set it the same on api and worker.

variables.name: ENDPOINT_AUTO_DISABLE_AFTER_HOURS
variables.description:
Hours of failures without a success before disabling, at least 1. Shorter than
DELIVERY_ESCALATION_HARD_CAP_HOURS on purpose.

variables.name: ENDPOINT_AUTO_DISABLE_MIN_FAILURES
variables.description: Failed attempts that window must also contain, so an idle endpoint is not disabled.

variables.name: ENDPOINT_AUTO_DISABLE_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Sweep interval (ms) and targets checked per sweep.

variables.name: ENDPOINT_AUTO_DISABLE_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Sweep interval (ms) and targets checked per sweep.

sections.title: Circuit breaker (Redis-backed, shared across worker pods)

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURE_RATE_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Failure rate that opens the circuit (percent, 0-100).

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MINIMUM_CALLS
variables.description: Calls needed before the failure rate is evaluated.

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_WAIT_DURATION_SECONDS
variables.description: Seconds the circuit stays open before probing.

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_WINDOW_TTL_SECONDS
variables.description: Sliding window of the failure counters (seconds).

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_SLOW_CALL_THRESHOLD_MS
variables.description: A call slower than this counts as slow, even with a 2xx (ms).

variables.name: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_SLOW_CALL_RATE_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Slow call rate that opens the circuit (percent, 0-100).

variables.name: DELIVERY_ESCALATION_HARD_CAP_HOURS
variables.description:
Hours after which a PENDING Delivery goes to the DLQ. Must cover the outgoing retry ladder's
worst case (~83h), or startup fails.

variables.name: DELIVERY_ESCALATION_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Deliveries per escalation batch.

variables.name: FORWARD_ESCALATION_HARD_CAP_HOURS
variables.description:
Hours from receipt after which an outstanding Forward goes to the DLQ; batch size and interval (ms).
Must cover the incoming retry ladder's worst case (~11h), or startup fails.

variables.name: FORWARD_ESCALATION_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description:
Hours from receipt after which an outstanding Forward goes to the DLQ; batch size and interval (ms).
Must cover the incoming retry ladder's worst case (~11h), or startup fails.

variables.name: FORWARD_ESCALATION_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description:
Hours from receipt after which an outstanding Forward goes to the DLQ; batch size and interval (ms).
Must cover the incoming retry ladder's worst case (~11h), or startup fails.

variables.name: DELIVERY_ESCALATION_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Stale delivery check interval (ms).

variables.name: QUEUE_DEPTH_METRICS_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Queue depth gauge refresh interval (ms).

variables.name: QUEUE_DEPTH_METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Only rows created within this many days are counted.

variables.name: TEST_ENDPOINT_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public origin of test endpoint URLs (…/hook/<slug>); defaults to APP_BASE_URL. Never an internal name.

variables.name: TEST_ENDPOINT_MAX_PER_PROJECT
variables.description: Test endpoints per project.

variables.name: TEST_ENDPOINT_MAX_TTL_HOURS
